posts.author: EuclidClassDunmer
posts.body:
Hi everyone. My name is Euclid, or on Youtube, I go by Euclidclassdunmer.
I am a mid-20s dude on the spectrum with a love of history, fantasy, and video games of course. I've had an account here for a long time, but I've never piped up about what I wish to do with this fantastic engine. I mostly keep to myself outside of videos, but I've decided this looks like a good community to be involved in considering what I've been wanting to do. I have not said anything because not only am I very awkward, I just now have started getting serious about making my game.
I have my own setting I have been writing for around 3 years now and I'm quite proud of it, I had an interest in RPG maker MV previously but due to circumstances in my life, I didn't have time to pursue making a game. I have written my story and setting and am quite satisfied with what I have. My world, the world my game takes place in, Wyvern Detachment, is what I'd call "Edwardian Fantasy" Not quite steampunk, not quite dieselpunk, all fantasy. I'd place the overall year of technological advancement at around 1905, maybe with less automobiles.
I have had RPG maker MZ for a while and it makes me really happy creating in it, I have a good understanding of Plugins, Events, switches, variables etc. And I have a rough understanding of parallax mapping, but the area I struggle with most is mapping in general, I am not very good at it and I will admit, I am VERY envious of some of the gorgeous maps I have seen.
Thank you very much for your time and for reading this, I hope to pester you all on many occasions asking for advice and tips.
